description:
Baa Baa Black Sheep: Where Does Warm Winter Wool Come From? — Baa baa black sheep, have you any wool? Yes sir, yes sir, three bags full! But how does sheep fluff turn into warm cozy sweaters?
Kids science answer for "baa baa black sheep rhyme for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

In springtime, farmers gently give sheep a quick haircut to collect fluffy fleece, which gets washed, spun into cozy yarn, and knitted into warm winter sweaters.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
